postProcessing: None. Generated transparent PNGs copied byte-for-byte; no drawing, recoloring, cropping or background removal.
registration: All variants replace the original active seal in the same centered rectangle and use its measured ActiveHole. Color is derived from the actual draft active slot; gaps never compact slot colors.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied HELLSCRIPT equipped active skill seal PNG. Create the SLOT 2 color variant. Change ONLY the existing bright emerald-green luminous edge to clear saturated sapphire BLUE (not cyan-green). Preserve all reference pixels and geometry as closely as possible: the same eight-point circular metal seal, antique gold and black iron filigree, circular opening, position, proportions and original 1254 by 1254 square canvas registration. This is a color-only edit of the existing narrow glow, not a redesigned frame. Retain the exact same tight hairline glow width and brightness. The metal itself stays antique gold/dark iron. No new rings, badges, numbers, letters, icons, symbols or ornament. The new colored illumination follows the actual inner and outer metal contours and pointed ornaments precisely. One isolated front-facing frame. Return a true transparent RGBA PNG with native alpha preserved: center aperture, surrounding empty pixels, gaps between ornaments, corners must remain fully transparent alpha 0. Preserve native transparency; no background, matte, checkerboard, scenery, shadow plate, solid color fill, enlarged bloom or crop. Keep the same resolution and centered registration for use in a Unity UI alongside the original green frame.
